title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027. The tour will take her through the United States and Canada as she continues a return to regular live work after stepping away from the road in 2025.

The route begins in Nashville and closes in Los Angeles, with Radio City Music Hall in New York and two nights at Massey Hall in Toronto among the larger rooms on the itinerary. Rather than stretching across an entire season, the tour is concentrated into roughly a month of shows.

The name Everything Begins plays on Young's "everything ends" tattoo, giving the tour a direct connection to the period she has just come through. She returned to the stage this year with two sold-out hometown shows at London's O2 Academy Brixton and a run of festival appearances, rebuilding the live schedule that had stopped the previous year.

Young also comes back to the road with a Grammy and new music behind her. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the 2026 Grammy Awards, while "From Down Here" arrived in May as her first new single since *I'm Only F**king Myself*. Made with James Blake, the song gave the next phase of her career a new recording of its own rather than simply extending the life of the hit that introduced her to a much wider audience.

[youtube:-u9TRlZADmg]

The scale of the rooms makes the announcement more than a routine list of dates. A New York landmark, two nights in Toronto and the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles place Young in significantly larger headline settings than the clubs that framed her earlier US shows. The compact routing also keeps the focus on a clear return rather than turning the tour into an endless itinerary.

Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. The first show is set for Nashville, with the run moving west through its final weeks before reaching Los Angeles. For Young, the tour turns a year of carefully rebuilding momentum into a sustained headline stretch, with new music now sharing the stage with the song that changed the scale of her career.
